sinopsis.es: La aclamada cineasta y escritora Miwa Nishikawa adapta su próxima novela en un drama de posguerra compasivo y lúcido sobre una huérfana de doce años que se hace pasar por niño, con una interpretación sobresaliente de la debutante Ami Koyae y un papel de reparto memorable de Koji Yakusho.
sinopsis.en: Acclaimed filmmaker and author Miwa Nishikawa adapts her forthcoming novel into a compassionate and clear-eyed postwar drama about a 12-year-old orphan who disguises herself as a boy, featuring a striking performance by newcomer Ami Koyae and a memorable supporting turn by Koji Yakusho.
